title: Katsushika Hokusai
summary: Japanese ukiyo-e artist, born in Edo (now Tokyo) in 1760 and died there in 1849. His print series Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji, which includes The Great Wave (dated 1831 by one source), made him one of the best-known Japanese artists worldwide.

uncertainty.note: Birth and death days come from one opened source (koenitz.com); the second opened source gives only years. Other scholarship may give a different birth day.

as_recorded.value: died on 10 May 1849 in Henjouin, Shouten-chou, Asakusa

where.modern_name: Tokyo, Japan (birth and death in Edo)

importance.justification: One of the most influential Japanese artists; The Great Wave is among the best-known images in world art.

sources.title: Hokusai: beyond the Great Wave (exhibition review), London Journal of Primary Care
